rule: Map one production sprint record set into allowed API routes, table fields, validation rules, smoke fixtures, and blocked payment routes before backend implementation starts.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, or commission endpoint is created in phase one; Heavyster earns listing SaaS only.

validations: equipment_listing_id must be visible and active
proof_snapshot_id must exist before enquiry submit
direct_route must be supplier email, phone, WhatsApp, or copied packet
supplier_account_id must be approved or in admin review
listing_subscription_id must match USD 9/month or USD 99/year listing SaaS
proof_document_ids must include at least one photo or document before publish
go_no_go must be pass, hold, or review
proof_score must be reviewed before scale
supplier_gap must create or update SupplierTarget records

acceptance: Shows one production route pack after Production Sprint Records.
Buyer route pack includes direct enquiry route, table, required fields, validation, fixture, and blocked rental payment route.
Supplier route pack includes equipment listing route, table, required fields, validation, fixture, and blocked payout route.
Founder route pack includes market signal route, table, required fields, validation, fixture, and blocked booking commission route.
Every route pack names one smoke fixture and one blocked payment route.
Static check protects version, UI, docs, route guardrails, fixture names, and contract.
